measure.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
measure.evidenceText: Price of Travel states that the Hostel Index price is per night including taxes and fees for one person in a shared dorm room, averaged over a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023. The table row is Prague, Czechia, PLUS Prague, $13.77.
measure.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; Hostel Index 2023
measure.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world Prague Czech Republic Hostel Index dorm bed price
measure.reason: Exact-city row (the source labels the country Czechia) and source methodology meet the shared-dorm, one-person, nightly, tax-included contract.
